# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## In the news

Read the latest press releases and media mentions.
[ Explore newsroom ][92]

## Insights

Access the newest in thought leadership.
[ Explore insights ][93]

# Careers with purpose

With a global presence and 44,000+ team members strong, AmerisourceBergen is committed to making a
difference in the future of health.
[ Explore careers ][94]

## to create healthier futures.

reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

and lens wearers in over 130 countries.^{†1} Our innovative products help millions of people see
better each day.

## Empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of clear eyesight

As your partner, we are dedicated to helping you achieve the practice you envision – every step of
the way. Whether it is a patient who needs your care or a customer who looks to you for advice, we
are here to help you shape the best customer experience. You can also count on us to help you run
and expand your business. With education and insights for you and your team. And by providing you
with support, technology and systems to optimize your practice. We consider our partnership
successful when you have everything you need: to empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of
clear eyesight.

[ Your business partner ][111]
[Close-up image of a HOYA lens]

## Our Vision Products

[ Vision products ][112]
Empower your patients to pursue their life’s vision, with solutions for every visual need.
[HOYA graphic grey lines]

#### Progressive lenses

Individualized and tailored to your patients’ unique lifestyles.

[See progressive lenses][113]

#### Sun solutions

Enhanced visual performance, comfort and protection in the most fashionable styles.

[See sun solutions][114]

#### Single vision lenses

Pixel-perfect precision and outstanding visual performance.

[See single vision lenses][115]
[HOYA graphic blue lines]

#### Special situation lenses

For the full spectrum of visual requirements: lenses for children, athletes and driving.

[See special situation lenses][116]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## “Together, we can tackle myopia in children”

Myopia progression can be controlled, not only corrected. Most spectacle lenses simply help the
child see clearly. While they correct vision, they don't help manage how myopia progresses over time
- that's why HOYA created MiYOSMART. At HOYA Vision Care, we are committed to helping children see
clearly and live fuller, more confident lives.

[ Discover our myopia management solutions ][117]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## Visionary Knowledge

[ Explore visionary knowledge ][118]
As an eye care professional, you invest years of education to develop and refine your expertise. It
is our mission to support and empower you in your journey. We will help you see what lies ahead: for
your staff, patients and customers. Ultimately, this vision is what makes your practice thrive.

## Empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of clear eyesight

As your partner, we are dedicated to helping you achieve the practice you envision – every step of
the way. Whether it is a patient who needs your care or a customer who looks to you for advice, we
are here to help you shape the best customer experience. You can also count on us to help you run
and expand your business. With education and insights for you and your team. And by providing you
with support, technology and systems to optimize your practice. We consider our partnership
successful when you have everything you need: to empower your patients’ lives, with the gift of
clear eyesight.

[ Your business partner ][111]
[Close-up image of a HOYA lens]

## Our Vision Products

[ Vision products ][112]
Empower your patients to pursue their life’s vision, with solutions for every visual need.
[HOYA graphic grey lines]

#### Progressive lenses

Individualized and tailored to your patients’ unique lifestyles.

[See progressive lenses][113]

#### Sun solutions

Enhanced visual performance, comfort and protection in the most fashionable styles.

[See sun solutions][114]

#### Single vision lenses

Pixel-perfect precision and outstanding visual performance.

[See single vision lenses][115]
[HOYA graphic blue lines]

#### Special situation lenses

For the full spectrum of visual requirements: lenses for children, athletes and driving.

[See special situation lenses][116]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## “Together, we can tackle myopia in children”

Myopia progression can be controlled, not only corrected. Most spectacle lenses simply help the
child see clearly. While they correct vision, they don't help manage how myopia progresses over time
- that's why HOYA created MiYOSMART. At HOYA Vision Care, we are committed to helping children see
clearly and live fuller, more confident lives.

[ Discover our myopia management solutions ][117]
[Girl playing outside wearing glasses with HOYA MiYOSMART lenses]

## Visionary Knowledge

[ Explore visionary knowledge ][118]
As an eye care professional, you invest years of education to develop and refine your expertise. It
is our mission to support and empower you in your journey. We will help you see what lies ahead: for
your staff, patients and customers. Ultimately, this vision is what makes your practice thrive.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

The Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) establishes critical steps for building a safer, more
transparent pharmaceutical supply chain in the United States. By registering your DSCSA information,
you help create an interoperable, electronic system to track and trace prescription drugs at the

* Quickly detect and respond to potential threats
* Ensure patient safety and trust in the medications they rely on

## Protect patients. Secure the supply chain. Register your DSCSA today.

The Drug Supply Chain Security Act (DSCSA) establishes critical steps for building a safer, more
transparent pharmaceutical supply chain in the United States. By registering your DSCSA information,
you help create an interoperable, electronic system to track and trace prescription drugs at the
package level.

Your participation is essential to:
* Prevent harmful or counterfeit drugs from entering the U.S. supply chain
* Quickly detect and respond to potential threats
* Ensure patient safety and trust in the medications they rely on

[[Actas Dermo-Sifiliográficas]][41]
ISSN: 0001-7310

The Official publication of the Spanish Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (AEDV). Actas
Dermo-Sifiliográficas, founded in 1909, is the oldest monthly medical journals published in Spain.
In the year 2006 has been indexed in the Medlinedatabase, and has become a vehicle for expressing
the most current Spanish medicine and modern. All articles are subjected to a rigorous process of
revision in pairs, and careful editing for literary and scientific style. Together with the classic
Original and Clinical Case Study sections, we also include Reviews, Case Diagnoses, and Book
Reviews. Dermo-Sifiliográficas is an essential publication for anyone who needs to be current on all
aspects of Spanish and world dermatology.

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules

  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they

manufacturing, and scale-up.

absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

precision cancer treatment.

native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

## EXPERTS IN OPHTHALMIC, ENT & DERMATOLOGicAl MEDICINES

Entod Pharmaceuticals is one of the leading International and researched based pharmaceutical
companies with over four decades of experience and speciality pharmaceutical expertise.

  

We specialize in Ophthalmic, ENT (Ear, Nose, Throat) and Dermatological (skincare) medicines, and
cater to the therapeutic needs of patients worldwide. Globally we have over 300 products in our
portfolio,  state-of-the-art manufacturing & research facilities, a global work force of over 2000
and highly experienced Quality Assurance, Production and R&D teams. Our products are sold in over 67
countries including the EU, UK , Africa and Asia. Our quality systems are certified in Europe and
our manufacturing quality standards adheres to international GMP norms.



Our speciality range includes eye drops, eye ointments, eye gels, intracameral injectables, ear
drops, nasal spray, gel serums, creams, ointments, lotions and solid & liquid orals designed for
global supply. Our therapeutic areas of expertise include dry eyes, digital eye strain, glaucoma,
eye infections, post-cataract & post-LASIK medication, upper & lower respiratory tract infections,
ear infections, analgesia, eczema, psoriasis, acne, anti-wrinkle, skincare, dark circle removal and
much more.

#### Ophthalmic Speciality Excipients

Our International Research Partners Entod Research Cell UK Ltd (ERC Labs) and Medisearch
Laboratories (Bombay) Pvt Ltd specialise in the development and production of High Purity Laboratory
Reagents and Specialized Pharmaceutical Excipients such as the **Stabilised Oxychloro Complex (SOC)

# Developing innovative therapeutic solutions for ophthalmic diseases

We are EyeD Pharma, a clinical stage pharmaceutical company dedicated to improve the life of
patients suffering from ophthalmic diseases with innovative sustained release micro-implants and
complex therapeutics.

[Glaucoma]

## Glaucoma

Glaucoma is an eye disease considered as the second cause of blindness worldwide, expected to affect
111,8 million people by 2040.

[Dry eye]

## Dry eye

About 1 every 11 people worldwide is affected by a form of Dry Eye Disease, with a daily detrimental
impact on vision, quality of life and work productivity.
[Back of the eye]

## Back of the eye

Chronic or post-surgery inflammation at the back of the eye (DME, RVO, posterior uveitis) can lead
to a permanent vision loss.

## We are on a journey to improve the quality of life of millions of patients

1,1 billion people are living with vision loss due to eye diseases that involve difficult treatments
with undesirable side effects. We are here to change that, by developing therapeutic alternatives
that could ensure 100% patient’s compliance. Our solutions could considerably reduce treatment side
effects, prevent further vision loss, and drastically improve the patient’s daily quality of life.

[ Get to know more about us ][17]
[We are on a journey to improve the quality of life of millions of patients]

## We aim to become a major player offering the best solutions in the pharmaceutical development of
## ophthalmic sustained release micro-implants and complex therapeutics.

Our promising pipeline is based on innovative drug delivery system, proven APIs and is designed to
address medical unmet need advised by internationally renowned KOLs.

Our product candidates could ensure a full compliance of the patient while drastically reducing or
even eliminating side-effects and avoiding degradation of the pathology.

[ Discover our pipeline ][18]

## We are on a mission to address some of the world’s greatest health challenges. Will you join us?

At EyeD Pharma, we’re always on the lookout for partners to push back the boundaries of innovation
in the service of patients. Let’s work together!

[ Partner with us ][19]
[EyeD Pharma]

# Developing innovative therapeutic solutions for ophthalmic diseases

We are EyeD Pharma, a clinical stage pharmaceutical company dedicated to improve the life of
patients suffering from ophthalmic diseases with innovative sustained release micro-implants and
complex therapeutics.

[Glaucoma]

## Glaucoma

Glaucoma is an eye disease considered as the second cause of blindness worldwide, expected to affect
111,8 million people by 2040.

[Dry eye]

## Dry eye

About 1 every 11 people worldwide is affected by a form of Dry Eye Disease, with a daily detrimental
impact on vision, quality of life and work productivity.
[Back of the eye]

## Back of the eye

Chronic or post-surgery inflammation at the back of the eye (DME, RVO, posterior uveitis) can lead
to a permanent vision loss.

## We are on a journey to improve the quality of life of millions of patients

1,1 billion people are living with vision loss due to eye diseases that involve difficult treatments
with undesirable side effects. We are here to change that, by developing therapeutic alternatives
that could ensure 100% patient’s compliance. Our solutions could considerably reduce treatment side
effects, prevent further vision loss, and drastically improve the patient’s daily quality of life.

[ Get to know more about us ][17]
[We are on a journey to improve the quality of life of millions of patients]

## We aim to become a major player offering the best solutions in the pharmaceutical development of
## ophthalmic sustained release micro-implants and complex therapeutics.

Our promising pipeline is based on innovative drug delivery system, proven APIs and is designed to
address medical unmet need advised by internationally renowned KOLs.

Our product candidates could ensure a full compliance of the patient while drastically reducing or
even eliminating side-effects and avoiding degradation of the pathology.

[ Discover our pipeline ][18]

## We are on a mission to address some of the world’s greatest health challenges. Will you join us?

At EyeD Pharma, we’re always on the lookout for partners to push back the boundaries of innovation
in the service of patients. Let’s work together!

[ Partner with us ][19]

# Welcome to EyeWiki

The Eye Encyclopedia written by Eye Physicians and Surgeons

EyeWiki is where ophthalmologists, other physicians, patients, and the public can learn about the
vast spectrum of eye disease, diagnosis, and treatment. Any qualified ophthalmologist or
ophthalmologist in training is [invited to contribute content to the wiki][16]. The work on this
site is a collaboration between the [American Academy of Ophthalmology][17] and [more than a dozen
societies][18].

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.

  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

  ### AI assistant enhances access to Investor Relations information
  
  Today, Fresenius has launched the AI-powered assistant – “AskFRE” – on its Investor Relations (IR)
  website, marking an important step in advancing its digital capital markets communications. The
  solution is a joint initiative of the Fresenius AI Center of Excellence and the Investor Relations
  team.With AskFRE, visitors can now interact with an integrated AI chatbot that provides direct
  answers to capital market-relevant information. This includes financial results, company updates
  and other IR content – based exclusively on publicly available Fresenius disclosures.In an
  increasingly fast-paced and data-driven environment, digital investor relations play a key role in
  delivering timely, transparent and stakeholder-focused communication. AskFRE supports this
  ambition by enabling more intuitive access to financial information and tailored user
  interactions, while reinforcing the consistency and accessibility of Fresenius’ disclosures.With
  AskFRE, Fresenius underscores its commitment to advancing a best in class digital investor
  relations experience.AskFRE is now available: https://www.fresenius.com/AskFRE-Your-IR-Assistant

* Brief News
  
  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.

  ### Fresenius publishes 2025 Annual Report – REJUVENATE: Delivering accelerated performance for
  ### long-term value creation
  
  Today, Fresenius published its 2025 Annual Report. As announced in late February 2026, 2025 marked
  another strong year of performance and the launch of the current phase of the #FutureFresenius
  strategy: Rejuvenate. Despite headwinds, the healthcare group achieved its outlook, which was
  raised twice during the year. Group revenue before special items rose to €22.6 billion, with
  organic growth of 7%, while constant currency Core EPS (excluding FMC) increased by 12%. “Over the
  past three years, we have successfully implemented our #FutureFresenius strategy and created a new
  Fresenius that is innovative, relevant, resilient, and adaptable. At the same time, we have
  significantly bolstered our company’s economic strength. We aim to build on this strong
  foundation,” said Michael Sen, Chairman of the Management Board of Fresenius. The 2025 Annual
  Report demonstrates how Fresenius is creating sustainable value for all stakeholders by executing
  its #FutureFresenius strategy. It includes the Sustainability Statement in accordance with the
  European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), and is available as a PDF and as an
  interactive online version in German and English. The online report features additional business
  stories and includes a video statement from CEO Michael Sen.

# Quality premix medications from a partner you can trust

A commitment to care

For more than 100 years, Fresenius Kabi has been a trusted global provider of essential medications.
As one of the largest IV bag manufacturers in the world, Fresenius Kabi offers an
expanding portfolio of manufacturer-prepared premix medications in innovative bags, so clinicians
can care with confidence.

Why Premix Matters

Premix medications are designed to help hospitals deliver safe, reliable, ready-to-use therapies
without the time and resource demands of sterile compounding. They serve as a dependable foundation
in medication management, allowing pharmacists to redirect expertise to patient-centered clinical
work.

[ Learn More ][13]
Fresenius Kabi: A century of experience

Fresenius Kabi is committed to bringing quality medicines and technologies to clinicians, when and
where they need them most.

EXPERIENCED

We are one of the largest manufacturers of IV bags in the world. We produce more than one billion IV
bags annually across all bag types.¹

RESPONSIVE

We have invested $100 million into our network of regional distribution centers across the U.S. to
get product to customers as quickly as possible.

INNOVATIVE

We worked with pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and nurses to develop our unique **free***flex*^{®}
bag technology for ease of use.

Easy to order, competitively priced

**Look for us:** Our core portfolio of commonly used premix medications are available on multiple
GPO contracts.

**free***flex*^{®} bag features are designed to help clinicians provide care safely
and efficiently

[ Learn More ][14]

**References**
1. Fresenius, Capital Markets Day 2023 presentation, slide 25. London, May 25, 2023.

Exceptional customer service

Fresenius Kabi’s service and products have received some of the industry’s highest certifications
and awards.

# Quality premix medications from a partner you can trust

A commitment to care

For more than 100 years, Fresenius Kabi has been a trusted global provider of essential medications.
As one of the largest IV bag manufacturers in the world, Fresenius Kabi offers an
expanding portfolio of manufacturer-prepared premix medications in innovative bags, so clinicians
can care with confidence.

Why Premix Matters

Premix medications are designed to help hospitals deliver safe, reliable, ready-to-use therapies
without the time and resource demands of sterile compounding. They serve as a dependable foundation
in medication management, allowing pharmacists to redirect expertise to patient-centered clinical
work.

[ Learn More ][13]
Fresenius Kabi: A century of experience

Fresenius Kabi is committed to bringing quality medicines and technologies to clinicians, when and
where they need them most.

EXPERIENCED

We are one of the largest manufacturers of IV bags in the world. We produce more than one billion IV
bags annually across all bag types.¹

RESPONSIVE

We have invested $100 million into our network of regional distribution centers across the U.S. to
get product to customers as quickly as possible.

INNOVATIVE

We worked with pharmacists, pharmacy technicians and nurses to develop our unique **free***flex*^{®}
bag technology for ease of use.

Easy to order, competitively priced

**Look for us:** Our core portfolio of commonly used premix medications are available on multiple
GPO contracts.

and efficiently

market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12

solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## Our Treatment Candidates

[

### Optic
### Neuritis

Up to 8 in 100,000 people worldwide suffer from optic neuritis¹, a disease that can lead to
permanent visual impairment with no specific therapy approved and mostly occurring in young adults

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

Breakthrough Therapy and PRIME designations granted for Optic Neuritis

### Privosegtor

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

][69] [

### Non-arteritic Anterior Ischemic Optic Neuropathy

Up to 10 in 100,000 people worldwide suffer from non-arteritic anterior optic neuropathy (NAION)²,
an acute optic nerve disorder with no approved therapy and permanent visual impairment in > 60% of
patients³.

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

### Privosegtor

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

][70] [

### Dry Eye Disease

>110 million people worldwide⁴ suffer from dry eye disease (DED), a multifactorial disease with a
dissatisfied and heterogeneous patient population⁵.

Licaminlimab, an anti-TNFα eye drop candidate specifically designed to treat ocular inflammation,
has the potential to transform the treatment paradigm of DED with a precision medicine approach.

### Licaminlimab

Licaminlimab, an anti-TNFα eye drop candidate specifically designed to treat ocular inflammation,
has the potential to transform the treatment paradigm of DED with a precision medicine approach.

][71]

**Privosegtor and Licaminlimab are investigational drugs and their safety or efficacy has not been
established and they have not received regulatory approval for commercial use in any country.**

## Visionary Innovation to Deliver Breakthrough Therapies

At the heart of our visionary innovation is a bold commitment to rethink what’s possible for
patients.  Guided by unmet medical needs and grounded in cutting-edge science, we are in pursuit of
health breakthroughs that go beyond incremental change. By redefining how we understand complex
diseases and with a relentless focus on highly differentiated development opportunities, we aim to
transform treatment approaches and bring a lasting impact to the lives of patients. 

Learn More About Our Scientific Approaches
[ Explore The Science ][74]

## Neuro-ophthalmic and ophthalmic innovations in development

[ Explore Our Clinical Trials ][75]

## Meet the team dedicated to making a real difference in patients’ lives

Our innovative pipeline has the potential to address key unmet medical needs in neuro-ophthalmology
and ophthalmology with treatments that are highly differentiated and have the potential to
completely change the current treatment paradigms. I am confident that our dedication to developing
transformative innovations, our patient-centric approach, and our focus on operational excellence
will ultimately make a real difference in patients’ lives.

[ Riad Sherif, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, Oculis ][76]

### Optic
### Neuritis

Up to 8 in 100,000 people worldwide suffer from optic neuritis¹, a disease that can lead to
permanent visual impairment with no specific therapy approved and mostly occurring in young adults

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

Breakthrough Therapy and PRIME designations granted for Optic Neuritis

### Privosegtor

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

][69] [

### Non-arteritic Anterior Ischemic Optic Neuropathy

Up to 10 in 100,000 people worldwide suffer from non-arteritic anterior optic neuropathy (NAION)²,
an acute optic nerve disorder with no approved therapy and permanent visual impairment in > 60% of
patients³.

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

### Privosegtor

Privosegtor, a novel peptoid small molecule that crosses the blood brain and retinal barriers, has
the potential to become the first neuroprotective therapy for optic neuropathies and other
neuro-ophthalmic diseases.

][70] [

### Dry Eye Disease

>110 million people worldwide⁴ suffer from dry eye disease (DED), a multifactorial disease with a
dissatisfied and heterogeneous patient population⁵.

Licaminlimab, an anti-TNFα eye drop candidate specifically designed to treat ocular inflammation,
has the potential to transform the treatment paradigm of DED with a precision medicine approach.

### Licaminlimab

Licaminlimab, an anti-TNFα eye drop candidate specifically designed to treat ocular inflammation,
has the potential to transform the treatment paradigm of DED with a precision medicine approach.

][71]

**Privosegtor and Licaminlimab are investigational drugs and their safety or efficacy has not been
established and they have not received regulatory approval for commercial use in any country.**

## Visionary Innovation to Deliver Breakthrough Therapies

At the heart of our visionary innovation is a bold commitment to rethink what’s possible for
patients.  Guided by unmet medical needs and grounded in cutting-edge science, we are in pursuit of
health breakthroughs that go beyond incremental change. By redefining how we understand complex
diseases and with a relentless focus on highly differentiated development opportunities, we aim to
transform treatment approaches and bring a lasting impact to the lives of patients. 

Learn More About Our Scientific Approaches
[ Explore The Science ][74]

## Neuro-ophthalmic and ophthalmic innovations in development

[ Explore Our Clinical Trials ][75]

## Meet the team dedicated to making a real difference in patients’ lives

Our innovative pipeline has the potential to address key unmet medical needs in neuro-ophthalmology
and ophthalmology with treatments that are highly differentiated and have the potential to
completely change the current treatment paradigms. I am confident that our dedication to developing
transformative innovations, our patient-centric approach, and our focus on operational excellence
will ultimately make a real difference in patients’ lives.

[ Riad Sherif, M.D., Chief Executive Officer, Oculis ][76]

##### [ Internal Medicine ][109]

[ View All Internal Medicine ][110]

We’re developing therapies to treat, slow, or prevent disease progression and improve the quality of
life for patients with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular and kidney diseases. 

[Inflammation and Immunology graphical thumbnail portrait image 3]

##### [ Inflammation & Immunology ][111]

[ View All Inflammation & Immunology ][112]

We look for treatments that provide more than just symptom relief, in order to address the root
cause of chronic inflammatory diseases at a molecular level

[Vaccine graphical thumbnail portrait image 4]

##### [ Vaccines ][113]

[ View All Vaccines ][114]

Vaccines are the single most important innovation in the science of health to significantly reduce
the threat of diseases that were once widespread and oftentimes fatal.

lives of cancer patients worldwide.

# Partners forHealthcare

We believe in abetter future forpeople and theplanet.

**We're investing in a better future for people and the planet.**

At Sofinnova Partners, we focus on breakthrough innovations that have the potential to solve the
world's most pressing problems. Experience, agility, and diverse points of view fuel our ability to
thrive in a complex environment.

Founded in 1972, Sofinnova Partners has backed more than 500 companies over 50 years, creating
market leaders around the globe. Today, Sofinnova Partners has over €4 billion under management.

"Partners for Life" is a cornerstone of our identity: we build lasting relationships with trust and
transparency. We invest in entrepreneurs who strive to transform biopharma, medtech, digital
medicine, agriculture and industrial processes with cutting-edge science that will contribute to
people's health and well-being.

## Our Funds

Sofinnova Partners is active across the entire value chain of life sciences investments, from seed
to later-stage, with a focus on healthcare and sustainability. Each of our funds is a manifestation
of our ability to recognize opportunity and unlock its potential with a dedicated team and a
tailored strategic approach.

[SofinnovaCapital][14]

The Sofinnova Capital Strategy is our flagship fund, investing as founding or lead investor in
early-stage biopharma and medtech start-ups developing groundbreaking therapeutic technologies.

[SofinnovaMD Start][15]

The Sofinnova MD Start Strategy is our in-house medtech accelerator focused on creating and
launching early-stage medtech companies through hands-on company building.

[SofinnovaCrossover][16]

The Sofinnova Crossover Strategy invests in growth-stage biotech and medtech companies that have
clinically validated their technologies and are preparing for commercialization.

[SofinnovaIndustrial Biotech][17]

Our Industrial Biotech Strategy invests in early-stage sustainable companies across the agriculture,
chemicals, food and materials sectors.

[SofinnovaTelethon][18]

The Sofinnova Telethon Strategy makes early-stage investments in leading Italian science for the
benefit of patients around the world.

[SofinnovaDigital Medicine][19]

Our Digital Medicine Strategy backs early-stage techbio and healthtech start-ups at the intersection
of biology, data, and computation.

[SofinnovaBiovelocita][20]

The Sofinnova Biovelocita Strategy is our biotech accelerator, partnering with leading research
organizations to create and build European biotech start-ups.

but has remained consistent."

"If you treat patients, you save lives, ultimately this is going to be good for investors. We
believe that by backing companies, whether early stage or later stage, that bring a product to
patients — ultimately this translates into financial return."

“I joined Sofinnova Partners because first of all, they have a fantastic brand in Europe, but it's
easy to see it is a very strong partnership. They're loyal to each other and everyone knows they
treat entrepreneurs well.”

# Partners forHealthcare

We believe in abetter future forpeople and theplanet.

**We're investing in a better future for people and the planet.**

At Sofinnova Partners, we focus on breakthrough innovations that have the potential to solve the
world's most pressing problems. Experience, agility, and diverse points of view fuel our ability to
thrive in a complex environment.

Founded in 1972, Sofinnova Partners has backed more than 500 companies over 50 years, creating
market leaders around the globe. Today, Sofinnova Partners has over €4 billion under management.

"Partners for Life" is a cornerstone of our identity: we build lasting relationships with trust and
transparency. We invest in entrepreneurs who strive to transform biopharma, medtech, digital
medicine, agriculture and industrial processes with cutting-edge science that will contribute to
people's health and well-being.

## Our Funds

Sofinnova Partners is active across the entire value chain of life sciences investments, from seed
to later-stage, with a focus on healthcare and sustainability. Each of our funds is a manifestation
of our ability to recognize opportunity and unlock its potential with a dedicated team and a
tailored strategic approach.

[SofinnovaCapital][14]

The Sofinnova Capital Strategy is our flagship fund, investing as founding or lead investor in
early-stage biopharma and medtech start-ups developing groundbreaking therapeutic technologies.

[SofinnovaMD Start][15]

The Sofinnova MD Start Strategy is our in-house medtech accelerator focused on creating and
launching early-stage medtech companies through hands-on company building.

[SofinnovaCrossover][16]

The Sofinnova Crossover Strategy invests in growth-stage biotech and medtech companies that have
clinically validated their technologies and are preparing for commercialization.

[SofinnovaIndustrial Biotech][17]

Our Industrial Biotech Strategy invests in early-stage sustainable companies across the agriculture,
chemicals, food and materials sectors.

[SofinnovaTelethon][18]

The Sofinnova Telethon Strategy makes early-stage investments in leading Italian science for the
benefit of patients around the world.

[SofinnovaDigital Medicine][19]

Our Digital Medicine Strategy backs early-stage techbio and healthtech start-ups at the intersection
of biology, data, and computation.

[SofinnovaBiovelocita][20]

The Sofinnova Biovelocita Strategy is our biotech accelerator, partnering with leading research
organizations to create and build European biotech start-ups.

"If you treat patients, you save lives, ultimately this is going to be good for investors. We
believe that by backing companies, whether early stage or later stage, that bring a product to
